svg.title: How a mistake becomes a guardrail
svg.desc: A factory conveyor belt. A person says not like that and hands over a red crate marked with an exclamation point. A clerk at the atone desk stamps it and writes it in a ledger, a press turns it into a rules scroll, and a worker at the hook forge hammers it into a green shield. A lift carries the shield up to join a rack of others.
svg.text: how a mistake becomes a guardrail
